plans.goal: Eliminate the Pale and Torn-ear wolves quickly, then focus overwhelming force on the Grey Mother
steps: Move squad to strong positions using the logs for cover
Focus fire on the Pale wolf to eliminate it first
Then concentrate on Torn-ear wolf before engaging the Grey Mother
Save focus fire for the boss when adds are down

atoms.text: Move to the fallen logs and establish firing positions
Focus fire on the Pale wolf to eliminate it quickly
Keep the Torn-ear wolf suppressed while we deal with the Pale wolf
Shift to the Torn-ear wolf and take it down before facing the Grey Mother
Sister Maud, stay covered and heal anyone who gets wounded
With the wolves down, all units attack the Grey Mother together

plans.goal: Suppress the wolves while hammering the Grey Mother with coordinated focus fire
steps: Position for overlapping fire coverage on all three beasts
Keep wolves at bay with defensive overwatch
Concentrate overwhelming force on the boss
Eliminate the Grey Mother before wolves can flank

atoms.text: Spread out to cover positions on the logs, don't bunch up
Pip and I hold the flanks and keep the wolves suppressed
Borin and Maud, concentrate fire on the Grey Mother's head
Hold positions and don't let the wolves get behind us
When we have the opening, everyone attack the Grey Mother together

plans.goal: Use controlled aggression to keep the Grey Mother pinned while Pip isolates and kills the wolves
steps: You and Borin advance on the Grey Mother and engage directly
Pip moves to flank and attack the wolves from the sides
Maud stays back and provides healing support
Maintain focus on the boss while wolves are contained

atoms.text: Advance toward the Grey Mother and engage her directly to keep her attention
Borin and I attack the Grey Mother together to pin her in place
Pip, move around to the sides and strike the wolves to keep them off us
If the wolves press in hard, hit them to make them hesitate
Maud, stay at range and heal anyone who gets mauled
Keep pressuring the Grey Mother, don't give her time to break away
